guide.intro: How LawBid works: who sees what, how your data is protected and which rules apply. Tap a section to open it.
guide.s1.body:
LawBid is a listing board: clients post cases and verified attorneys send offers (bids) on them.

LawBid is not a law firm, does not give legal advice and is not responsible for the attorney's work or the outcome of a case.

You agree on payment with the attorney and pay them directly.
guide.s1.title: How we work
guide.s2.title: Who sees your case
guide.s3.body:
Before a bid is accepted, an attorney may write to you in the case chat. There you appear as the client of the case, without your name. Phone numbers and emails in messages are hidden automatically, and photos and documents cannot be sent.

Once you accept a bid, the chat with that attorney opens fully: files can be sent and contacts are no longer hidden. The attorney sees the contacts from your profile in the case if they have an active subscription or trial. Before your first case you agree that your contacts go to the attorney whose bid you accept. The other attorneys' chats about this case become read-only.

If you close the case, active bids are declined and its chats become read-only.
guide.s3.title: Contacts and chat
guide.s4.body:
An attorney can add assistants. A new assistant has no rights at all. The attorney switches on each duty separately and accepts full responsibility for the assistant's actions, including under their state's rules on supervising non-lawyer staff. A duty can be switched off at any time.

Duties: calls, chats, files in chats, cases, bid drafts, posts, tasks, profile, sending bids and publishing without approval.

An assistant with access to cases sees the details of the attorney's cases, including the private details of cases where the attorney's bid was accepted. An assistant with access to chats sees all of the attorney's chats, and their messages are labelled as the assistant's.
guide.s4.title: Attorney assistants
guide.s5.body:
Photos and documents of cases and chats are kept in private storage. They open only through a secure link that works for one hour. An attorney's verification documents open through a 5-minute link and only for reviewers. Every file is checked by an antivirus, and only clean files are shown.

Message texts are stored encrypted on the server (AES-256).

A sent message cannot be deleted or edited.

LawBid staff see data only for support, for reviewing reports and when the law requires it.
guide.s5.title: Files and messages
guide.s6.body:
A bid is an attorney's offer on your case: the price, the terms and when they can start. Only verified attorneys with an active subscription or trial can send bids. If the subscription ends, their pending bids are withdrawn. If the case is outside the attorney's practice areas, the bid is marked and you see it.

Case stages: Published, Bids, In progress, Wrapping up, Completed. When one side taps «Done», the other confirms or opens a dispute, and a LawBid moderator handles the dispute. Without an answer the case closes by itself after 7 days.

You agree with the attorney yourselves on the payment, its amount, method and timing, and pay them directly. LawBid takes no part in these payments and is not responsible for them.

If you no longer need the case, close it. If you have not opened an open case for a while, we ask whether it is still needed: for «Very urgent» after 2 days, «Urgent» after 4, «This week» after 7, «Within a month» and «No rush» after 30. The question comes between 9:00 and 21:00 your time. Without an answer the case is paused after 1, 2, 3, 4 and 14 days respectively, and a case with a date 3 days after that date. After 30 days on pause the case goes to the archive. You can put it back in the feed with one tap. Only your own actions count. These are the default periods.
guide.s6.title: Bids, case stages and payment
guide.s7.body:
After a case is closed, the client can review the attorney whose bid they accepted, and the attorney can review the client. A review can be edited during the editing period and cannot be deleted in the app.

You can report a post, comment, message, case, review, user or sticker pack. Content reported by 3 different people is hidden until a moderator decides. Reports on profiles and cases are reviewed by a moderator. A moderator can remove content, restrict or block an account.

A block works both ways: you do not see each other and cannot message each other. A block does not close the chat of a case that is already in progress.

Phone numbers, emails and links are not allowed in a case title or brief, the city, case comments or reviews: such text is not saved.
guide.s7.title: Reviews, reports and rules
guide.s8.body:
You can delete your account in Settings. After the request you are signed out on all devices, and after 14 days the account is anonymized. If you sign in during those 14 days, the deletion is cancelled.

Anonymization replaces your name, replaces the text of your messages with «[deleted]», and removes your profile photo, verification documents, files and voice notes you sent, posts and follows. Open cases go to the archive, cases in progress are closed and the other side is notified. An attorney's subscription is cancelled.

The case log, records of contact disclosure, consents and sign-in records are kept for 5 years without your personal data.

Before deleting you can download your data in Settings.
